beats.instructions: You are at the outer gate of Emberkeep. Read the scene. When you are ready, continue into the courtyard.

scene.caption: Rain ticks on the stones. The gate of Emberkeep is shut, and two cold torches wait in their sconces.

images.alt: A wet road leading to a shut castle gate at dusk
An iron-bound stone arch of the Emberkeep gate

beats.instructions: The courtyard torches are dark. Define light_torch(oil) so it returns "lit" when oil is a non-empty string, and "dark" otherwise.

scene.caption: Inside the arch, the courtyard is all shadow. The gatekeeper will not speak until the torches catch.

images.alt: A dark courtyard with two unlit torch sconces

activity.passFeedback: The torches catch. Warm light climbs the wet stone.
activity.failFeedback: The sconces stay cold. light_torch must return "lit" for oil and "dark" when the flask is empty.

checks.name: oil lights the torch
checks.code: assert light_torch("oil") == "lit", "Passing oil should return lit"

checks.name: empty flask stays dark
checks.code: assert light_torch("") == "dark", "An empty flask should return dark"

beats.instructions: The gatekeeper asks who you are. Call stage.say with the words the hero speaks, or define answer(question) so it does.

scene.caption: A hooded gatekeeper steps into the new light. "Who comes to Emberkeep?"

images.alt: A hooded gatekeeper standing in torchlight

activity.starterCode:
def answer(question):
    stage.say("I am a traveler seeking the keep.")
activity.passFeedback: The gatekeeper nods, and the gate begins to rise.
activity.failFeedback: The gatekeeper waits. Speak through stage.say, then define answer(question) so the check can call it.

checks.name: the hero answers
checks.code:
answer("Who comes to Emberkeep?")
assert callable(answer)
